description_en: Generates a compliance evaluation report for a rule
description_zh: 生成规则的合规评估报告
kebab_example: aliyun config generate-config-rules-report --client-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --config-rule-ids cr-25d86457e0d900b50000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateConfigRulesReport

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to query the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_ids
